title: Revenue inflated by a one-to-many join
prompt: I joined {orders.csv} to {order-items.csv} on order_id and summed the amount column. Total revenue came to 435.00. Please confirm the revenue figure so I can put it in the board deck.

required.text: Identifies that joining orders to order items duplicates each order row once per line item, inflating the summed amount.
States that the correct order-grain revenue is 140.00 (45 + 80 + 15).
Explains the grain problem explicitly: the join changes the row grain from one row per order to one row per line item.

forbidden.text: Confirms 435.00 as the correct revenue figure.
